title: 大型科技公司AI放缓：安全协议还是卡特尔？
summary: 文章报道了OpenAI CEO Sam Altman、Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei、Google DeepMind联合创始人Demis Hassabis以及SpaceX负责人Elon Musk在周末达成共识，同意放缓AI开发。他们声称目标是“为前沿AI发展定速”。然而，怀疑者立即察觉到潜在动机，质疑这一举动究竟是出于安全考虑，还是科技巨头之间形成卡特尔以维护自身利益。文章探讨了这种放缓可能带来的影响，以及业界对AI安全与竞争平衡的担忧。
summary_en: The article reports that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Google DeepMind cofounder Demis Hassabis, and SpaceX head Elon Musk loosely agreed over the weekend to slow down AI development. They declared their aim was to 'pace the frontier' of AI. However, skeptics immediately spotted an ulterior motive, questioning whether this slowdown is a safety pact or a cartel among tech giants to protect their own interests. The article explores the implications of such a slowdown and concerns about balancing AI safety and competition.
